about: A tool that turns test coverage data from C and C++ compilers into readable reports.

prs.title: Coveralls reports work outside a git checkout
prs.broken: Asking for a Coveralls report from a source tarball or a Docker build without git history made the tool crash and write no reports at all.
prs.changed: I made the git check accept a no, so the report is simply written without the git details.
prs.matters: Builds from release tarballs and containers get their coverage reports again.
